# au

> Async Utils - A lightweight, convention-over-configuration async framework for Python


## Pages in this subsection

- [au](au.html.md): AU - Asynchronous Utilities
- [au.api](au.api.html.md): Simplified API for AU - direct task submission without decorators.
- [au.backends](au.backends.html.md): &#92;&#95;&#92;&#95;init&#95;&#92;&#95;.py for au.backends package
- [au.backends.rq_backend](au.backends.rq_backend.html.md): RQ (Redis Queue) backend for au framework.
- [au.backends.supabase_backend](au.backends.supabase_backend.html.md): Supabase PostgreSQL queue backend for au framework.
- [au.base](au.base.html.md): Asynchronous computation framework with pluggable backends.
- [au.config](au.config.html.md): Configuration management for AU with convention-over-configuration support.
- [au.hooks](au.hooks.html.md): Enhanced hooks and observability for AU.
- [au.http](au.http.html.md): HTTP interface for AU task management.
- [au.retry](au.retry.html.md): Retry policies and error handling for AU.
- [au.testing](au.testing.html.md): Testing utilities for AU.
- [au.workflow](au.workflow.html.md): Workflow and task dependency management for AU.
